items.q: My first impression of Charles Mingus, as I recall it, was the impression that remained with me throughout my friendship and exposure to Charles Mingus

ctx.x: Would you like to comment at all about Charles Mingus and your activity with him, your relationship with him, your impressions of Charles Mingus?

My first impression of Charles Mingus, as I recall it, was the impression that remained with me throughout my friendship and exposure to Charles Mingus, in that it was that Charles Mingus marched to the beat of his own drum and to the beat of no other drum. He was a maverick in the classic sense of the word. He did not speak with forked tongue. He was oftentimes categorized as being controversial.
